Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the issuing authority for the administrative notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance is the department responsible for publishing this customs and value added tax related notification.

S.R.O. 195-AIN/2025: This is a statutory regulatory order issued by the government under its legal authority to regulate customs matters.

Customs Act 2023: The Government is empowered under sub-section (1) of section 25 of this Act to issue notifications and amendments in the interest of the public.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: This Act provides the legal authority under sub-section (1) of section 126 for the Government to issue and amend regulatory orders in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as the consultative body for the Government in exercising powers to modify customs and tax regulations.
S.R.O. 163-AIN/2024: This existing notification is being formally amended to update specific tariff and duty-related tables and conditions.
TABLE-1: This table is amended to include additional Heading 72.25 and 72.26 entries along with their respective HS Codes and product descriptions.
TABLE-2: The existing table is replaced in its entirety with a new version containing updated HS Codes and descriptions for various iron, steel, and industrial components.
Goods Description: The amendment updates specific product classifications including silicon sheets, cold-rolled sheets, HR coil sheets, MS shafts, metal washers, and blank stators within the tariff schedule.
H.S. Code: New HS Codes are inserted into the tariff tables to categorize specific industrial goods, including various steel sheets and machinery parts, for duty assessment purposes.
Casing Manufacturing Equipment: The regulatory conditions are updated to define the specific types of machinery, including casing heater, bush fitting, and die casting machines, eligible under the relevant manufacturing concession.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ২। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ২ জুন, ২০২৫ খ্রিস্টাব্দ তারিখে কার্যকর হইবে।

Statutory Regulatory Order: The effective date for the implementation of the provisions contained in this regulatory order is established for early June of the calendar year.
